note: Re-judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge after the fix round (2691e815b1); only the positive's claim comment changed. RFC 7296 3.14: "Senders MUST select a new unpredictable IV for every message; recipients MUST accept any value." This row's tests carry the recipient clause (the sender clause is RFC7296-3.14-2). TestSKAcceptsAnyIVOnReceipt now claims the three IVs it sends (all-zero, all-ones, ascending) and decrypts each to the exact single Delete payload through decryptAndParse; its claim points the repeated IV to TestRFC7296RecipientAcceptsAnIVTheSenderShouldNotHaveChosen, which decrypts a repeated IV and the previous final ciphertext block used as IV, the inputs a policing recipient would refuse. Claim and body now agree; the earlier defect is resolved. Revert records on auth.go::decryptSKPayload for both units.
